sentences.text:
Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 The Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ PETITION.No.13952 of 2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, and learned Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for respondents. 2(A).

The petitioners have approached this Court seeking the following relief:
"to issue a writ or order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the inaction of the 3rd respondent in not passing any orders on the application dated 02.01.2023 submitted by the petitioner as arbitrary, contrary to law and against the principles of natural justice"
2(B).

It is the specific case of the petitioners that petitioners vide their representation dated 02.01.2023 addressed to the 3rd respondent herein i.e., Revenue Divisional Officer, Toopran, Medak District, Telangana State had requested the 3rd respondent not to issue cheques in respect of land renumbered as Sy.No.291/1,2, Old Sy.No.292,
situated at Kallakal Village, Manoharbad Mandal, Mandal, Medak District, in view of pending civil disputes over the subject land but however the 3rd respondent without even considering petitioners representation dated 02.01.2023, was proceeding and issuing cheques releasing compensation to the respondent No.4 and aggrieved by the said action the petitioners filed the present writ petition.
3. Learned Government Pleader for Revenue, on instructions, submits to the Court that though the cheques are made ready, they have not yet been handedover to the 4th respondent.

entities.text: Revenue Divisional Officer, Toopran, Medak District, Telangana State
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Learned Government Pleader further submits that writ itself could be disposed off directing the 3rd respondent to resolve the subject issue under Sections 76 and 77 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by fixing a reasonable period.

sentences.text:
4.
